_doc: The independent reviewer's open-weight models, run on the Actions runner itself (zero API cost, no key). PROTECTED. The workflow runs the Ollama archive only when its sha256 matches `archive_sha256`; a model is asked only when the sha256 of its manifest file on disk matches its `digest`. A null or changed pin means nothing runs and the review queues (REVIEW_UNAVAILABLE). Pin each value from the 'archive sha256' and 'manifest sha256' lines a review run prints.
